command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='d7c792ff0a591011fa64c86e2f37bb85a111687f'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'adb='; command -v adb || true; printf 'emulator='; command -v emulator || true; if command -v adb >/dev/null; then adb version; adb devices -l; fi; if command -v emulator >/dev/null; then emulator -version | head -3; printf 'avds:
'; emulator -list-avds; fi; printf 'sdk_root=%s
' "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-}}"; find "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-/nonexistent}}" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'system-images' -o -name 'platform-tools' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
